I think a lot of the things that Michael brought up I think are the trap. Which is if you don’t have a brand that can stand out in some way in the mind of the consumer, in crowded categories you just drown. So there’s got to be something that feels like fundamentally unique or compelling about the product. Whether it’s price or availability or brand personality. I think all of those things can work. But it’s very different than trying to assess a B2B software company.
